rows.html:
• Budgeting
• Rolling and continuous forecasting
• Integrated P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow planning (indirect cash flow)
• Driver-based planning
• Top-down and bottom-up planning

• Tagetik is the established enterprise EPM planning foundation supporting the financial forecast and rolling forecast
• Statutory P&L and balance-sheet inputs flow through HFM/IDS
• Driver based forecast is implemented with significant challenges requiring manual adjustments
• Tool issues have been pointed by finance. Investigation exposed model-complexity, scalability, performance and maintenance challenges. These are not all proven tool limitations and further studies are required.
• Top-down / bottom-up planning: Tagetik provides governed centralized models, but flexible multi-level entry, allocation and reconciliation rules still require design and validation; transparent hybrid planning is the proposed target state

• AI-enabled forecasts
• Driver-based and AI-based predictive forecasting
• Business-owned modeling agility
• Interactive scenario simulation and what-if analysis
• Embedded and explainable AI
• Indirect cash forecast in BS

• Long-range strategic planning
• Strategy-to-financial-plan linkage
• Capital investment and portfolio planning
• Project financial planning
• Profitability, cost and margin planning

• Strategic Planning is live in Tagetik EPM and Tableau; the 2026 cycle covers 2025–2030 and went live on March 20, 2026
• Target setting remains partly Excel/OPUS-based
• Strategic Plan 2.0 design, simplification and data-flow formalization are underway

• What-if and sensitivity analysis
• Scenario management
• Probabilistic and stochastic simulation
• Predictive forecasting
• External-driver modeling
• AI-assisted plan generation
